title: One Step of Reversal on Encoded Pairs
statement: For any two bit strings $u$ and $v$, there exist bit strings $u'$ and $v'$ such that applying the specified reversal step to $\langle u,v\rangle$ gives $\langle u',v'\rangle$, and $\operatorname{reverse}(u')\mathbin{++}v'=\operatorname{reverse}(u)\mathbin{++}v$. Their total length is preserved: $|u'|+|v'|=|u|+|v|$. If $u$ is nonempty, then $|u'|<|u|$; if $u$ is empty, then $u'$ is empty.
hypotheses_covered: u and v are arbitrary bit strings
